parsed.step_description: Create a Gantt chart or similar visual representation of the project timeline.

parsed.step_description: Review and adjust the schedule as needed throughout the project lifecycle.
parsed.current_solution: Regularly update the project plan and communicate changes to stakeholders using project management tools.

parsed.step_description: Define functional requirements and user stories.
parsed.current_solution: Use user story mapping, wireframing, and personas to define requirements.

parsed.step_description: Document all requirements in a structured format like User Stories or Requirements Document.
parsed.current_solution: Follow industry standards like IEEE 829 for documenting technical specifications.

parsed.step_description: Ensure that all stakeholders understand and agree to the documented requirements.
parsed.current_solution: Organize workshops, training sessions, and Q&A forums to clarify requirements.

parsed.step_description: Update documentation regularly as new information becomes available.
parsed.current_solution: Maintain an online wiki or issue tracking system for continuous updates.

parsed.step_description: Prepare acceptance criteria for each feature or requirement.
parsed.current_solution: Specify clear acceptance criteria in test cases or acceptance criteria documents.

parsed.step_description: Brainstorm design concepts and wireframes.

parsed.step_description: Select a prototyping tool like Figma or Sketch to create interactive prototypes.
parsed.current_solution: Choose a prototyping platform that supports real-time collaboration and accessibility.

parsed.step_description: Test prototypes with users to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments.
parsed.current_solution: Conduct usability testing, gather feedback, and iterate on the prototype.

parsed.step_description: Refine designs based on user feedback until final versions are approved.
parsed.current_solution: Iterate on the design based on user feedback, incorporating changes in subsequent iterations.

parsed.step_description: Generate mockups and UI components ready for development.
parsed.current_solution: Export mockups and UI elements in vector formats like SVG or PNG.

parsed.step_description: Implement the selected design into the software architecture.
parsed.current_solution: Use version control systems like Git for managing changes and collaborating on codebase.

parsed.step_description: Write unit tests and integration tests to ensure functionality.
parsed.current_solution: Employ automated testing frameworks like Jest, Mocha, or Selenium for testing.

parsed.step_description: Perform regression testing after changes are made.
parsed.current_solution: Automate regression tests using tools like TestComplete or Selenium Grid.

parsed.current_solution: Use load testing tools like LoadRunner or Gatling for comprehensive testing.

parsed.step_description: Debug any bugs found during testing and fix them.
parsed.current_solution: Utilize debugging tools like Chrome DevTools, Visual Studio Debugger, or Postman for identifying and fixing bugs.

parsed.step_description: Conduct thorough QA checks before deployment.
parsed.current_solution: Implement static code analysis tools like SonarQube or ESLint for code quality assurance.

parsed.step_description: Automatically deploy the application to staging environments.
parsed.current_solution: Use CI/CD pipelines with tools like Jenkins, CircleCI, or GitLab CI for automating deployments.

parsed.step_description: Monitor performance and stability in staging environments.
parsed.current_solution: Use monitoring tools like New Relic, Datadog, or Splunk for real-time performance insights.

parsed.step_description: Roll out production updates if everything is stable.
parsed.current_solution: Execute rollouts using CD/Delivery pipelines with tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet for controlled updates.

parsed.step_description: Communicate release details to relevant teams and stakeholders.
parsed.current_solution: Use communication channels like Slack, email, or internal messaging apps for transparent release communications.

parsed.step_description: Gather customer feedback through surveys, interviews, or analytics.
parsed.current_solution: Utilize customer relationship management (CRM) tools like Salesforce or HubSpot for collecting feedback.

parsed.step_description: Analyze feedback to identify areas for improvement.
parsed.current_solution: Process customer feedback using sentiment analysis tools like IBM Watson Tone Analyzer or Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK).

parsed.step_description: Propose improvements and enhancements based on feedback.

parsed.step_description: Reiterate these suggestions back to the development team.
parsed.current_solution: Share feedback with developers through regular status meetings and retrospectives.

parsed.step_description: Iterate on the product based on ongoing feedback and evolving needs.
